title: Paṭisallāṇā
text: 1 Sāvatthi || Tatra kho || voca || || 2 Paṭisallāṇe bhikkhave yogam āpajjatha paṭisallīno bhikkhave bhikkhu yathā bhūtam pajānāti || || 3 Kiñca yathābhūtam pajānāti || Rūpassa samudayañca atthagamañ ca || Vedanāya samudayañca atthagamañ ca || Saṅkhārānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañ ca || 4 Yathā pathamasutte tathā vitthāretabbo || ||
